name: csharp-solution-lsp
description: csharp-ls bound to one solution of the project root, so a repository with worktrees or several solutions never gets one picked at random. Uses the solution named in .claude/csharp-ls-solution, else the only .sln or .slnx in the project root. Needs csharp-ls on PATH (dotnet tool install -g csharp-ls).
